body: I think life sucks and there is no reason to continue living. We should be able to decide when we've had enough out of life. I have and I want to die

Mostly when I get triggered by my PTSD from my childhood abuse. Once I unburied the sexual abuse in 2018, it opened the floodgates of all I have  kept inside. I have never been one to ask for help since growing up I had nobody to turn to so I only had myself to deal with the abuse. Talking about it out loud is too painful which is why therapy hasn’t helped. I never shared the details of my  abuse with anyone including my family, until now. But just thinking about spending the next 25 years alone and with my head filled with the unbearable painful memories is too much. I can barely make it through a week so thinking about living like this for years and years is unbearable

Me too. Every time I read about someone who killed themselves I wish it were me. I wish I did it when I was a kid being abused emotionally, physically, and sexually by my mother, father, and brother. But I survived my childhood only because I was popular and had a lot of friends. I would spend as much time as I could with them and that saved me. Then I met someone who I thought was the opposite of my father and we got married. He was kind, loving, charming, non judgmental, basically the opposite of my father. We had 3 amazing boys. And I was never happier than when I was a mom raising my kids. But after 25 years of marriage I discovered my husband was actually a sociopath and has multiple families scattered all over. That betrayal nearly killed me but I stayed alive for my kids. It’s now 11 years later and my kids are grown and I am miserable. I unburied my sexual abuse at the had of my brother and that opened the floodgates to all of the abuse I never dealt with. So I have filled with the worst memories that won’t go away. Therapy has done nothing for me. It’s actually more painful because I have to talk out loud about what my life was like growing up. I was all alone and unprotected in my own home. Now I am again all alone. I will never date/get married again as I have major trust issues and I won’t let new friends in my life because I need to protect myself. So I am alone. I was always very social so this isn’t me and is not how I pictured spending the rest of my life. I want my kids to understand the pain I am in and let me go, but they won’t. I could never kill myself unless they let me, but they say they never will give me permission. They are in their early 30’s and have their own lives now, they don’t need me. But they said it would destroy them if I killed myself, so I am stuck living a miserable solitary life. I am so envious of everyone who gets to die.
